name: 12point5
description: Established in 2020 by two young cycling commuters, Paul Martichoux and Diego Delamare, who came up with the idea of converting the 12.5 square meters of unused underground parking space into multiple secure spots for two-wheelers.

name: AB Tasty
description: AB Tasty is a customer experience optimization platform that helps businesses increase conversions and user engagement through a SaaS suite of tools for A/B testing, website personalization, feature management, push marketing, NPS, and analytics.

name: Aerospacelab
description: Aerospacelab is a Belgian, vertically integrated company specializing in the development, manufacturing, and operation of advanced satellite technologies. It collects and processes geospatial data to deliver actionable intelligence for a wide range of industries.

name: airfocus
description: Airfocus is a modular and strategic product management platform that enables teams to prioritize tasks, build clear roadmaps, and align on strategy through customizable templates and seamless integrations.

name: Animaj
description: Animaj is a next-generation media company that acquires and aggregates YouTube Kids channels and children’s IPs, using AI and data to turn them into engaging, multiplatform franchises.

name: Apiax
description: Apiax is a regulatory technology company that digitizes compliance workflows, providing embedded solutions that help financial institutions navigate complex regulations efficiently and drive business growth.

name: Arcure
description: Arcure is a specialist in artificial intelligence and embedded vision, providing solutions like Blaxtair to improve industrial safety and productivity by detecting pedestrians and obstacles around machinery.

name: AssoConnect
description: Nonprofits are innovative, hardworking and deserve the best tools out there. AssoConnect is an all-in-one nonprofit software to help nonprofits focus less on admin, and more on their impact. Today, AssoConnect helps 15,000 nonprofits around the world, of all sizes and sectors. Main features: CRM, Membership Management, Online Payment, Communication, Website Builder, Event Management and more.

name: Ateme
description: Ateme is a global leader in video compression and delivery solutions, offering innovative technologies to broadcasters and content providers for efficient and high-quality video streaming experiences.

name: Believe
description: Believe is a leading digital music company that supports independent artists and labels worldwide through online distribution, marketing, and promotion services, helping them grow their audience and revenue across more than 50 countries.

name: Bergamotte
description: Bergamotte is an online florist offering fresh, seasonal flower bouquets, plants, and home gifts for delivery, with a focus on quality, creativity, and sustainability.

name: Bigblue
description: Bigblue is a fulfillment-as-a-service platform for e-commerce brands, enabling them to scale effortlessly and enhance the customer experience through fast and reliable logistics.

name: Calixar
description: Calixar is a biotechnology company specializing in the isolation and stabilization of fully native, full-length membrane proteins in solution, preserving their structural and functional integrity to support drug discovery and therapeutic development.

name: Carbonable
description: Carbonable is a DeFi-powered platform that enables companies and individuals to invest in high-quality carbon offset projects through a marketplace of tokenized assets. By leveraging NFTs backed by stablecoins and offering high yields, Carbonable facilitates sustainable investment and supports global decarbonization efforts.

name: Chauffeur Privé
description: Chauffeur Privé, now part of FREE NOW, was a French ride-hailing platform offering premium private car services. Integrated into the FREE NOW mobility ecosystem, it contributed to building a unified app that provides users across Europe with access to taxis, private drivers, and micromobility options such as scooters—all within a single, seamless experience.

name: Citilog
description: Citilog specializes in intelligent transportation systems, providing video-based monitoring solutions to improve traffic flow and enhance road safety in urban environments.

name: Codenvy
description: Codenvy, now part of Red Hat OpenShift Dev Spaces, offers cloud-based development environments that allow developers to code, build, and test applications collaboratively without local setup.

name: Coinhouse
description: Coinhouse is a Neo Crypto Bank that enables individuals and institutions to buy, sell, and manage digital assets like Bitcoin and Ethereum, offering secure storage and expert advisory services.

name: Colette
description: Colette’s mission is perfectly aligned with Mutuelle Impact’s investment thesis: maintain physical and mental health of senior people through increased social interactions and increased revenue. On the one hand, it helps students and young workers to find simple and affordable housing, in better quality and more spacious accommodations, by living with hosts who have a room to rent. On the other hand, it allows hosts to rent out their vacant rooms to young people in complete confidence, and get additional income. Above all, it’s a clever way to break solitude and create links. The offer is based on technology stacks and automation of processes, delivering fluid and transparent matching.

name: Commanders Act
description: Commanders Act is a marketing data platform that helps large websites—such as retailers, banks, and media companies—collect, structure, and activate customer data without relying on cookies. Its solutions include tag and consent management, as well as a Customer Data Platform, enabling optimized marketing performance and compliance with privacy regulations.

name: Core Biogenesis
description: Core Biogenesis is a biotechnology company that uses plants as biofactories to produce cost-efficient recombinant proteins and growth factors for applications in cell therapy—such as treatments for neurodegenerative diseases and cancer—as well as in the development of cultivated meat and skincare.

name: Currency Cloud
description: Currencycloud is a cloud-based payment engine that enables businesses to manage cross-border payments and foreign exchange with ease. Through its API-driven platform, Currencycloud offers real-time currency conversion, multi-currency accounts, and global payment processing, helping financial institutions and fintechs scale international transactions efficiently and transparently.

name: Dattak
description: Dattak provides proactive cyber insurance and cybersecurity services for SMEs, combining risk assessment, continuous monitoring, and comprehensive coverage to protect against cyber threats.

name: Dealt
description: Dealt is a key B2B2C platform that enables businesses to offer white-label services—such as installation, assembly, maintenance, and gardening—through a catalog of over 350 options, helping them enhance customer experience and stand out in the market.

name: Destia
description: Destia is the French leader in home care. This network of local agencies relies on more than 5,000 caregivers to improve the quality of life of elderly people who are dependent and/or living with disabilities at home. Its motto: “to respect, and even enhance, their autonomy.” This investment is part of the Mutuelles Impact Large Cap fund pocket.

name: Diagnoly
description: Co-founded in March 2020 by Ivan Voznyuk (PhD in Applied Mathematics) and Dr. Edwin Quarello (KOL obstetrician-gynecologist), Diagnoly is an AI-powered medical screening company that significantly improves ultrasound care through cutting-edge artificial intelligence. Focused on prenatal mother-fetal medicine and women’s health, Diagnoly’s solutions enhance the accuracy of prenatal screening. A winner of the 2020 i-Lab competition, Diagnoly was recognized as a DeepTech company twice (March 2020 and January 2022).

name: DivRiots
description: DivRiots is a software company that builds tools to empower front-end teams, enhancing efficiency and collaboration. Its flagship product, Backlight.dev, is a specialized development environment for Design Systems, offering advanced collaborative features for both developers and designers.

name: Dogami
description: Dogami is a mobile-first, blockchain-based game where players adopt, raise, and trade 3D NFT dog avatars. Set in the ‘Petaverse’, the game blends augmented reality and play-to-earn mechanics, allowing users to adopt, play, earn, and socialize with their virtual companions.

name: Dolead
description: Dolead is the world’s first Leads-as-a-Service platform, specializing in generating exclusive, sales-ready leads through AI-driven paid media campaigns. By combining proprietary semantic technology with customer data integration, Dolead delivers scalable and sustainable customer acquisition solutions for businesses.

name: DynAdmic
description: DynAdmic is a digital video advertising platform that uses proprietary audio recognition technology and programmatic bidding to target audiences based on video content context, ensuring brand safety and optimized campaign performance.

name: Ed.ai
description: Ed.ai is an AI assistant that pre-grades assignments in half the time, identifies each student's learning gaps, and generates personalized remediation, deployed in secondary schools across France and the US.

name: Ekinops
description: Ekinops is a provider of open and interoperable telecommunications solutions, offering optical transport, access, and software-defined technologies to empower networks worldwide.

name: Elba
description: Elba is the modern security hub for modern teams. With their plug-and-play solution, they detect security issues and guide the end-users on how to fix them.

name: Eldim
description: ELDIM specializes in the design and manufacturing of optical measurement systems, with a focus on evaluating the viewing angle performance of displays and other optical components.

name: Elum Energy
description: Elum Energy is an AI-driven energy management platform that provides controllers and software to monitor and optimize the energy mix of solar power plants and microgrids, improving efficiency, reliability, and sustainability.

name: Ensweet
description: Founded in 2021 by Fabien Watrelot, Ensweet is a French MedTech company specializing in remote cardiac rehabilitation. Its hybrid solution, based on digital tools and expert human support, allows cardiac patients to access a home-based care program, in close collaboration with their medical team. Ensweet raised €3M in Seed funding in May 2025, in a round led by Mutuelles Impact, alongside AG2R LA MONDIALE, Angels Santé, Nord France Amorçage (NFA), 50 Partners, Finovam 2, and makesense, and several business angels specializing in health.

name: Epigene Labs
description: Epigene Labs develops advanced epigenetic and genomics-driven tools to accelerate precision drug discovery in oncology. By leveraging insights into gene expression and regulation, the company enables the design of targeted therapies tailored to individual cancer profiles.

name: Epoca
description: Epoca is a mission-driven company that develops a hybrid technological and human solution for remote home monitoring of elderly patients with complex multiple pathologies, either over the long term or temporarily during acute phases.

name: Eptica
description: Eptica Lingway provides AI-powered recruitment and talent management solutions built on a proprietary HR semantic dictionary of over one million terms. Its software suite supports HR professionals in sourcing, matching, and managing talent through advanced semantic search, predictive recruitment, and data normalization across multiple systems.

name: ErgoSanté
description: ErgoSanté designs and manufactures custom ergonomic solutions to improve workplace health, safety, and inclusion. Its product range includes adaptive office furniture for both disabled and able-bodied employees, as well as industrial exoskeletons that help prevent musculoskeletal disorders (MSDs) through physical support and strain reduction.

name: Estuaire
description: Estuaire is a carbon accounting platform tailored to the aviation industry, leveraging detailed flight data to assess environmental impact and simulate effective decarbonization strategies.

name: Ethik-IA
description: Ethik-IA is the leading operator of human oversight for AI in healthcare. The company provides guidance to both users and developers of health-related AI solutions, offering support in implementing compliance validation processes aligned with the upcoming European AI Act.

name: Etsy
description: Etsy is a global online marketplace where individuals can buy and sell handmade, vintage, and unique goods, fostering a community of creative entrepreneurs and shoppers.

name: Evaneos
description: Evaneos is a travel marketplace that connects travelers with local travel agents around the world to design unique, tailor-made multi-day trips, promoting more authentic and sustainable travel experiences.

name: Eve (Emulation and Verification Engineering)
description: Emulation & Verification Engineering (EVE) provides hardware-assisted solutions for the verification of complex integrated circuits (i.e. System-on-Chips or SoC).

name: Fidor Bank
description: Fidor Bank was a digital bank based in Germany, known for its innovative approach to banking services.

name: Flink
description: Flink makes it easier to order groceries from your phone and receive them 15 minutes later. The startup wants to differentiate itself with a full-stack approach and operates its own micro-fulfillment centers.

name: getinside
description: getinside is a French technology platform connecting brands with curated creator communities to design and execute performance-driven marketing campaigns. It enables companies to activate authentic customer voices at scale, managing everything from campaign setup to performance tracking. By combining marketplace dynamics with SaaS tools, Getinside helps brands drive measurable acquisition and engagement through trusted digital channels.

name: gitti
description: Gitti is a beauty brand specializing in innovative, sustainable, and vegan nail polish products, promoting eco-friendly beauty choices for consumers.

name: Gladia
description: Gladia is an AI software provider offering advanced speech-to-text transcription, translation, and audio intelligence through asynchronous and real-time APIs, enabling accurate and efficient voice data processing at scale.

name: Gleamer
description: Gleamer develops AI-powered solutions for radiology, serving as a clinical companion to help radiologists detect lesions such as bone fractures and lung nodules on X-ray images, improving diagnostic accuracy and workflow efficiency.

name: Goodays
description: Goodays offers a customer engagement platform that helps businesses manage in-store and online interactions in real time. Its software suite enhances customer satisfaction and loyalty through personalized communication and feedback management.

name: Green Fusion
description: Green Fusion provides AI-driven energy optimization solutions that integrate renewable energy sources to support the decarbonization of residential real estate, helping businesses and communities reduce consumption and enhance sustainability.

name: Greenly
description: Greenly offers a digital platform for carbon accounting, helping companies measure, reduce, and offset their carbon emissions to achieve sustainability goals.

name: HelloBetter
description: HelloBetter develops digital medical devices for mental health, offering a catalog of clinically validated programs targeting conditions such as insomnia, depression, stress, and anxiety. Designed to be prescribed by healthcare professionals, these solutions support patients through evidence-based, digital therapeutic interventions.

name: Homaio
description: Homaio is a climate-focused investment platform that enables individuals to invest in carbon assets designed for both financial returns and environmental impact. With a singular focus on reducing CO₂ emissions, Homaio offers access to regulated carbon markets, empowering investors to fight climate change while building a high-impact portfolio.

description: Homerez is a property management platform for vacation rentals that simplifies the booking process for owners by managing listing creation, multiposting across rental sites, and handling bookings and payments — all through a centralized solution designed to maximize occupancy and ease operations.

name: Impika
description: Developer of industrial inkjet printing solutions for high-speed commercial, security, and packaging applications.

name: Implicity
description: IMPLICITY developed a remote monitoring platform for patients with connected pacemakers and defibrillators. Designed for cardiologists and healthcare professionals, it automates remote monitoring of their patients. An artificial intelligence module determines the criticality of each alert considering the medical context of the patient.

name: Intent Technologies
description: Intent Technologies offers a cloud platform that connects all stakeholders in the real estate sector—managers, service providers, software, and connected objects—to enhance the efficiency and attractiveness of buildings and urban areas.

name: Iptego
description: IPTEGO GmbH develops software and hardware appliances for the Voice over IP (VoIP) industry, specializing in VoIP gateways and network solutions that enhance communication infrastructure and interoperability, acquired by Acme Packet then by Oracle.

name: Itris Automation
description: Itrs Automation developed software to improve productivity and code quality in industrial automation and embedded systems. Its solutions supported more efficient and reliable development processes and were ultimately acquired by Schneider Electric.

name: Jobvalley
description: Jobvalley is Germany’s leading digital platform and temporary job agency for students and graduates, connecting them with flexible work opportunities and supporting their transition from education to professional life.

name: JOIN
description: JOIN has developed a software to help brands and content creators produce stories that can be published across all channels, from websites to social media platforms. At XAnge, we are convinced that web pages will progressively jump into the stories format in the coming years, as it is a powerful way to showcase creators’ contents, drive engagement or create a brand experience.

By identifying at-risk populations, Kiplin offers personalized prevention programs—including a subscription-based corporate service (“UP”) and in-person events—designed to drive long-term behavior change and improve health outcomes.

description: KissKissBankBank is a crowdfunding platform that enables individuals and organizations to finance creative and entrepreneurial projects through public contributions.

description: Knowunity is the digital learning companion for students around the world. Founded in 2020, the platform combines personalized AI technology with student-generated content to make learning simpler, more engaging, and more successful. With over 6 million monthly users across 15+ countries, Knowunity is one of the fastest-growing educational platforms in the world.

name: Le Fourgon

name: Make me Reach

Now part of Paragone, the platform continues to empower marketers with advanced tools for cross-channel campaign management and performance optimization.

name: mindDay
description: mindDay reinvents mental wellness by combining human guidance, digital programs and science to provide immediate and personalized support to anyone.

name: Mirsense
description: Mirsense develops advanced gas sensors based on quantum cascade laser (QCL) technology, enabling high-precision detection and analysis for industrial, defense, and security applications.

name: Mister Spex
description: Founded in 2007, Mister Spex is a multi-award-winning company that has become the leading digital native omnichannel opticial brand in Europe. The company has grown from a pure online player into a successful omnichannel optician with more than five million customers and more than 40 physical retail stores in Germany, Austria and Sweden. The focus of Mister Spex is to make eyewear purchase for customers an easy, transparent and fun shopping experience by combining a comprehensive and varied range of high-quality products with optician expertise and services.

name: Naskeo
description: Naskeo specializes in designing, constructing, and operating anaerobic digestion plants that convert organic waste into renewable energy, contributing to sustainable waste management and energy production.

name: Nelson
description: Nelson Mobility is a B2B software platform that helps companies electrify their corporate vehicle fleets. Founded in 2022, it aggregates companies' existing mobility data — fuel card transactions, driver mileage, home locations — and cross-references them with charging infrastructure and vehicle range data to generate automatically updated, driver-level electrification roadmaps. Its approach allows fleet managers to identify conversion-ready drivers and meet French decarbonization mandates without costly manual audits.

name: Neobrain
description: Neobrain is an AI-powered SaaS platform for strategic talent management, enabling organizations to identify internal skills, monitor performance, support upskilling, and drive internal mobility. Its solution includes four core modules: skill mapping via AI, performance tracking, personalized learning aligned with employee aspirations, and AI-based internal mobility planning.

name: Neolane
description: Neolane was a French software company specializing in cross-channel campaign management and marketing automation. Its platform enabled brands to orchestrate personalized marketing campaigns across email, SMS, social media, and more, all from a unified interface. In 2013, Neolane was acquired by Adobe to enhance the Adobe Marketing Cloud (now Adobe Experience Cloud), strengthening its capabilities in data-driven and real-time campaign execution.

name: Nestaq
description: Netasq was a French cybersecurity company specializing in unified network security appliances. It provided integrated firewall, intrusion prevention (IPS), and VPN technologies tailored for businesses and public sector organizations. Netasq’s solutions later became Stormshield’s next-generation network security offerings following its fusion with Arkoon.

name: News Republic
description: News Republic was a personalized news platform that used AI technology to deliver relevant, real-time content tailored to each user’s interests. Now as part of ByteDance, it leverages the group’s advanced content recommendation infrastructure and is available globally alongside products like TikTok and TopBuzz.

name: Odoo
description: Odoo offers a comprehensive open-source suite of business applications—ranging from CRM and accounting to e-commerce, inventory, and project management—providing a flexible cloud ERP solution tailored for SMEs of all sizes.

name: Omie & Cie
description: Omie is a purpose-driven food brand delivering low-carbon, organic dry products co-developed with local producers. Committed to regenerative agriculture, Omie ensures full transparency on ingredient sourcing and fair compensation, supporting both healthy ecosystems and sustainable farming practices.

name: One Up
description: OneUp is a cloud-based ERP solution for small and medium-sized businesses, offering integrated tools for accounting automation, invoicing, bookkeeping, and inventory management to streamline operations and improve financial visibility.

name: OuiHelp
description: Ouihelp provides personalized home care services for seniors in France, offering tailored support to improve their quality of life and maintain autonomy at home.

name: Peerby
description: Peerby is a peer-to-peer marketplace that enables individuals to borrow or rent items from neighbors, promoting a circular economy and reducing unnecessary consumption through local sharing.

name: Pina.Earth
description: Pina Earth is a SaaS company that enables forest owners to access the voluntary carbon market by digitizing the certification process using remote sensing and AI. It offers CO₂ certificates from German forests, supporting the transition from vulnerable monocultures to climate-resilient mixed forests to boost carbon sequestration and biodiversity.

name: Planetary
description: Planetary builds, owns, and operates a global network of fully integrated fermentation facilities to scale sustainable biomanufacturing. Focused on biomass and precision fermentation, the company enables the production of bio-based products across various industries by expanding global bioprocessing capacity.

name: Pony
description: Pony enables cities to offer sustainable and decentralized micro-mobility solutions through a unique shared ownership model, fostering local engagement and reducing operational costs.

name: Popsink
description: Popsink is a no-code platform for real-time data integration, enabling business users to build non-intrusive, incremental data pipelines and transform live data streams across systems—without relying on engineering resources.

description: PrestaShop is an efficient and innovative e-commerce solution with all the features companies need to create an online store and grow their business.

name: Promus
description: Promus is a digital wholesaler that connects local producers directly with restaurants through a streamlined distribution platform. By eliminating unnecessary intermediaries, Promus aims to bring farmers back to the center of the food chain and promote more transparent, sustainable sourcing in the restaurant industry.

name: Qubit Pharmaceuticals
description: Qubit Pharmaceuticals is a physics-driven drug discovery company that leverages quantum physics, advanced simulation software, and AI-enhanced medicinal chemistry to develop novel drug candidates and innovative mechanisms of action targeting complex diseases.

name: Raisin
description: Raisin is a fintech company that operates an online marketplace for savings and investment products, giving consumers access to competitive interest rates and financial offerings from banks across Europe.

name: Reelevant
description: Reelevant is a real-time email targeting platform that enables businesses to send dynamic, personalized, and context-aware emails, improving customer engagement and boosting conversion rates.

name: Reflect
description: Reflect is a people analytics platform specifically designed for HR teams, enabling them to centralize and monitor all key workforce indicators in one place. The tool helps organizations make data-driven decisions to support talent management, employee engagement, and HR strategy.

name: Request Finance
description: Companies, DAOs, and Freelancers use Request to easily manage crypto invoices, salaries, and expenses in a fast, non-custodial, and compliant way.

name: ResidSocial
description: ResidSocial is a solidarity housing provider that acquires run-down social hotels to transform them into dignified residential facilities, enabling vulnerable families referred by social services to rebuild their lives through stable housing and a comprehensive network of support programs.

name: Roctool
description: Roctool specializes in heat-and-cool molding technologies using induction, offering advanced materials processing solutions that improve manufacturing efficiency and product quality across industries such as automotive, electronics, and consumer goods.

name: Roof
description: ROOF is a coliving platform that provides fully furnished shared flats for students and young professionals. Designed to offer comfort, affordability, and a strong sense of community, ROOF simplifies urban living through all-inclusive services and flexible rental terms in major French cities.

name: Run My Process
description: RunMyProcess offers a low-code platform that enables organizations to automate, integrate, and streamline business processes, facilitating digital transformation and operational efficiency.

name: SamanTree Medical
description: SamanTree Medical provides advanced intraoperative imaging solutions to support cancer surgery. Its Histolog® Scanner enables near real-time visualization of resection margins on fresh tissue, helping surgeons assess tumor removal and accelerating pathological verification during procedures.

name: Saporo
description: Saporo is a Swiss cybersecurity company specializing in internal attack surface management. Its platform helps organizations anticipate and prevent cyberattacks by identifying, prioritizing, and mitigating risks linked to identities, permissions, and system configurations.

name: Sculpteo
description: Sculpteo is an online 3D printing service that offers digital manufacturing solutions, enabling businesses and individuals to produce prototypes and end-use products using a variety of materials and technologies.

name: Sensorberg
description: Sensorberg provides intelligent access control and IoT infrastructure software for PropTech environments, digitizing and automating access to commercial real estate and self-storage facilities through integrated hardware and software solutions.

name: Shine

name: Shopmium
description: Shopmium is a mobile application that provides users with exclusive offers and cashback deals on everyday products, enhancing shopping experiences and savings.

name: Sidetrade
description: Sidetrade provides an AI-powered platform that optimizes the entire order-to-cash process, helping businesses accelerate cash flow, reduce churn, and unlock value from customer relationships. Its next-generation AI, Aimie, leverages a proprietary global database of payment behaviors to deliver predictive insights and intelligent automation—enhancing decision-making, streamlining collections, and improving collaboration between finance and sales teams.

name: Silvr
description: Silvr provides revenue-based financing solutions for digital entrepreneurs, offering fast and flexible funding without equity dilution to support business growth.

name: Sinequa
description: Sinequa is a leader in AI-powered enterprise search, providing organizations with a platform to access and analyze vast amounts of data, enhancing decision-making and innovation.

name: Sirona

name: Skello
description: Skello was created in 2016 with a simple but ambitious mission: to make life easier for all physical retailers by revamping the way they worjk with their teams. All of this through an intelligent planning and staff management tool.

description: Smart Tribune provides AI-powered selfcare solutions that help large enterprises and high-traffic websites enhance customer satisfaction while reducing support costs. Through dynamic FAQs, chatbots, personalized help widgets, and community forums, the platform empowers users to find fast, effective answers and reduces level 1 support inquiries.

name: Stane Groupe
description: Stane supports healthcare entrepreneurs in the creation and operation of primary care centers across France. Capitalizing on the rapid development of multidisciplinary health centers (MSPs) as alternatives to hospitals and isolated private practices, Stane aims to build France’s leading network for integrated urban healthcare. Its mission is to meet public health challenges while addressing the needs of all healthcare stakeholders.

name: Stealth Startup

name: Sunacare
description: SunaCare is a German company that offers an online platform for 24-hour in-home elderly care, connecting families with qualified caregivers to provide personalized support and improve the well-being and autonomy of seniors.

name: Surgar
description: SurgAR is a French MedTech startup, spun out from CHU Clermont-Ferrand and the EnCoV (Endoscopy and Computer Vision) research group. It develops AI- and AR-powered software to support minimally invasive surgery. By providing surgeons with augmented intraoperative views that highlight tumors and masses in real time, SurgAR enhances surgical planning, navigation, and decision-making—ultimately improving precision, reducing complications, and lowering reintervention rates.

name: Sweagle
description: Sweagle is a SaaS platform for Configuration Data Management (CDM) of enterprise applications, enabling better visibility, control, and automation of complex configuration data. Acquired by ServiceNow, Sweagle strengthens IT operations management by reducing configuration-related risks and improving system reliability.

name: Synapse Medicine
description: Synapse Medicine is an AI-powered platform that supports healthcare professionals in making safe and effective prescribing decisions. By providing reliable, up-to-date drug information and clinical decision support, it integrates seamlessly with electronic health records and e-prescription tools to enhance medication safety.

name: sêmeia
description: Sêmeia builds MedicWise, a certified remote patient monitoring platform enabling care teams to track chronic disease patients in real time, with automatic collection of biological data integrated into existing hospital systems. Its NephroWise solution has led the nephrology telemonitoring market in France for seven years, used by over 350 care teams to monitor 15,000 patients.

name: Teeptrak
description: TEEPTRAK offers a set of all-in-one, autonomous and external solutions for monitoring the performance of any production equipment, physical values or a set of manual tasks.

name: Tomorro
description: Tomorro is a legal tech company that leverages artificial intelligence to automate and streamline contract management. Designed to free businesses from the burdens of manual legal processes, the platform enables legal and operational teams to focus on innovation and strategy. name: Genspark
description: Genspark是景鲲与朱凯华创立MainFunc公司推出的AI Agent产品，旨在通过多代理框架提供个性化和高效的信息检索服务。Genspark 的核心是其 AI 智能体引擎，由多个专门设计的 AI 智能体组成，每个智能体都能够针对特定类型的查询和信息需求提供专业服务。Genspark定位于重建网络，提供无广告、无偏见的高质量信息，解决传统搜索引擎的不足。

name: Habby
description: Habby 是一家海外游戏发行公司，于 2018 年在新加坡创立，定位于中度休闲游戏，主打产品有《弓箭传说》、《弹壳特攻队》、《SSSnaker》等。

name: Manus
description: Manus 是一款通用型 AI 助手，能将想法转化为行动：不止于思考，更注重成果。Manus 擅长处理工作与生活中的各类任务，在你安心休息的同时，一切都能妥善完成。

name: Nuro
description: Nuro是真格基金在2016年投资的早期项目，是一家专注于研发自动驾驶货运车辆的公司。公司致力于通过机器人改善人们日常生活。公司研发的电动自动驾驶汽车用于将任何所需物品送到消费者家中。Nuro希望通过便利环保的以全自动配送为中心的解决方案，让街道更安全、城市更宜居。Nuro已经在德克萨斯州、亚利桑那州和加利福尼亚州的社区试运行了自动化本地配送服务。

name: Opay
description: OPay是真格在2019年投资的早期项目，是尼日利亚的一家移动支付服务商和出行服务商。由全球知名浏览器公司Opera在2018年孵化，专注非洲和中东市场，提供移动支付、共享出行与外卖等服务。

name: Qbit
description: Qbit趣比汇是真格在2021年投资的早期项目，致力于搭建为企业提供一站式资金跨境流转的平台，让客户拥有更加便捷，高效，低成本的跨境支付体验。 以技术为驱动，以安全合规为根本，同时结合最前沿的区块链技术，研发新一代的跨境清结算网络，基于此提供全球收款（Global Collection）, 全球付款（Global Payout）以及量子卡（Virtual Payment Card），覆盖客户资金跨境流转的全方面需求。

name: Uwant
description: UWANT就选是真格在2021年投资的天使项目，是一家专注于智能清洁领域，集智能研发-生产-销售一体的互联网科技创新家电品牌。

name: Yahaha
description: Yahaha Studios是真格在2020年投资的早期项目，是一款面向全球用户的无代码多人互动内容创作平台，致力于打造3D互动内容与社交平台。进一步推出适用于近“零基础”创作者的平台，创作者将以无代码的方式进行3D互动内容的创作，并一键发布至Yahaha的平台与社区，支持多人同时在线的体验，降低传统3D实时内容特别是游戏内容在创作、测试、发行以及变现等全部环节的准入门槛。

name: 与光科技
description: 与光科技是真格基金在2020年投资的早期项目，公司专注于为全球客户提供先进的光谱芯片、AI算法和智慧感知方案，为行业赋能，支撑客户高效发展。公司创新性成果快照式CMOS超光谱成像芯片具有精度高、成本低、可量产的优势，将为智能手机、医疗器械、机器视觉、增强现实、自动驾驶、智慧城市等行业拓展新的传感维度。

name: 中科睿医
description: 中科睿医是由中国科学院科研成果转化创建的创新医疗科技成长型企业。基于荣获国家科学技术进步奖的神经科学前沿成果，集聚产学研一体化的医工交叉研发实力，提供面向神经系统疾病筛、诊、治、研全场景的智能解决方案。以全球视野，立足神经科学与人工智能交叉融合和产业落地的前沿，兼具新型软硬件和AI技术能力，致力于解决老龄化与神经系统疾病给人类社会带来的巨大挑战

name: 乐享科技 JoyIn
description: 乐享科技成立于 2024 年 12 月，是一家专注于 AI、机器人技术研发及产品应用的高科技企业。致力于打造“AI+机器人”时代下的新一代家庭智能移动硬件终端。 希望用前沿技术构建未来家庭生活方式，普及解放人类，提升社会幸福感。

name: 云天励飞
description: 云天励飞是真格基金在2015年投资的天使项目，是一家国内领先的拥有AI算法芯片化能力的数字城市整体解决方案提供商。公司致力于通过AI技术进行物理世界结构化，打造数字孪生城市。依托国际化专家团队和“全栈式”AI技术平台，公司打造了面向公共安全、城市治理、新商业等领域的产品和解决方案。2021年8月份，云天励飞科创板上市过会。

name: 云洲无人船
description: 云洲智能是真格基金在2015年投资的早期项目，是一家专注于无人船艇研发、生产、销售与提供行业解决方案为一体的高科技企业。目前已先后推出环境监测无人船、海洋调查无人艇、安防救援无人艇等自主知识产权产品，获得海洋科学技术奖特等奖、海洋工程科学技术奖特等奖、环境保护科学技术奖、中国专利奖等多项大奖。

name: 亿航
description: EH) 是真格基金在2014年投资的天使项目，是一家全球领先的智能自动驾驶飞行器科技企业。公司致力于让每个人都享受到安全、自动、环保的空中交通。亿航为全球多个行业领域客户提供各种自动驾驶飞行器产品和解决方案，覆盖空中交通（包括载人交通和物流运输）、智慧城市管理和空中媒体等应用领域。

name: 优艾智合
description: 优艾智合是真格基金在2019年投资的早期项目，是一家以机器人研发与制造为核心的创新型高新技术公司，具有完全自主知识产权的移动机器人核心算法，拥有大量业务场景无人化改造经验。公司基于移动机器人，致力于提供智能制造、智能巡检及维保等覆盖全行业、全方位的产品和解决方案。

name: 依图科技
description: 依图科技从事人工智能创新型研究，是真格基金在2013年投资的天使项目。公司致力于全面解决看、听、理解和规划的根本问题，为人工智能的发展和应用普及提供高性能、高密度和通用的算力，满足云端数据中心、边缘计算和物联网不断增长的智能计算需求。依图的全栈自研技术已经服务于智能城市、智能医疗、智能商业等多个领域。

name: 元古
description: 元古是真格在2020年投资的天使项目，公司创建于2016年，以二十四节气为灵感，从胡同里一家中式甜品店开始，逐渐走向一个融合中式节气下午茶和中式餐酒体验的生活方式品牌。

name: 兴盛优选
description: 兴盛优选是真格在2018年投资的早期项目，是一家关注民生的互联网“新零售”平台。主要定位于解决家庭消费者的日常需求，提供包括蔬菜水果，肉禽水产，米面粮油，日用百货等全品类精选商品。依托社区实体便利店，通过“预售+自提”的模式为用户提供服务。

name: 内外
description: NEIWAI内外是真格基金在2015年投资的天使项目，专注于贴身衣着舒适体验的中高端内衣品牌。 NEIWAI内外自一件无钢圈舒适内衣开始，本着“尊重女性身体感受”的设计理念创作内衣，致力于探寻舒适、功能与美感的平衡。产品现已覆盖至女性与男性的日常、家居、运动等场景。品牌倡导真实多元审美，并通过满足女性在不同场景下的产品需求，鼓励女性探索关于自己身体与内心的更多可能。

name: 初速度
description: Momenta是真格基金在2016年投资的天使项目，是一家全球领先的自动驾驶公司。公司致力于通过突破性的AI科技，创造更美好的未来智慧出行。为实现可规模化的完全无人驾驶，Momenta基于数据驱动的“飞轮”技术洞察，以及量产自动驾驶（Mpilot）与完全无人驾驶（MSD）相结合的“两条腿”产品战略，提供不同级别的自动驾驶解决方案。

name: 厨芯
description: 厨芯是真格基金在2017年投资的早期项目，是全球领先的餐饮设备和服务提供商。厨芯科技从一台智能洗碗机开始，致力于改变餐厅后厨基础设施，驱动餐饮行业的智能化和自动化。其首创的AIoT餐厅洗碗解决方案，主要从“联网智能洗碗机+高倍净力小桶上墙清洗剂+即速响应服务+数据化管理工具”全面解决餐厅洗碗难题，比传统洗碗方案清洁标准高、效果可控、更省心。

name: 可糖
description: COFANCY可糖是真格在2019年投资的天使项目，母公司多趣美学是一家美妆产品电商企业，致力于拓展更多色彩美妆产品，诠释色彩美学；秉承着帮助用户，建立用户之中更广泛的情感共识 。COFANCY可糖是一家快速成长的互联网快速消费品公司，主要自营品类有美瞳、彩妆等。

name: 品峰医疗
description: 品峰医疗是真格基金在2020年投资的天使项目，公司致力于打造智慧检验的新一代体外诊断龙头企业。其定位是从临床需求出发，集传统诊断与跨界技术于一体，提供未来诊断的整体解决方案。品峰创新是一个开放性的研发模式，自主研发是品峰医疗生命力的源泉，外部合作助推产品和能力的升级换代。用Build-Buy-Collaborate模式快速建立一个体外诊断平台型的公司。公司未来将聚焦于打造高效的智慧检验科，并为更广泛的智慧检验生态圈提供核心产品。

name: 图灵视频
description: 图灵视频是真格基金在2017年投资的天使项目，一家人工智能领域的高科技公司。公司专注于计算机视觉和机器人领域，为智慧安防、智慧地产等应⽤领域提供包括AI视频分析和巡逻机器⼈产品的⼀体化的服务解决⽅案。公司推出的创新性产品将主要面向视频监控、机器人辅助安防以及物联网等市场。

name: 地平线
description: 地平线是真格基金在2016年投资的天使项目，公司自主研发兼具极致效能与开放易用性的边缘人工智能芯片及解决方案，可面向智能驾驶以及更广泛的智能物联网领域，提供包括效能边缘 AI 芯片、丰富算法IP、开放工具链等在内的全面赋能服务。

name: 安途
description: AutoX是真格基金在2016年投资的天使项目，公司致力于打造无人驾驶核心大脑的软硬件一体化系统。 通过最先进的人工智能和大量的中国复杂城市路况的数据，自主研发L4/L5级别无人驾驶全栈解决方案。 AutoX是中国目前唯一一家实现城市公开道路完全空车无人驾驶RoboTaxi运营的公司， 具有国内规模最大的RoboTaxi车队。

name: 官栈
description: 官栈是真格基金在2020年投资的天使项目，母公司广东参之源健康科技有限公司是一家定位于以标准化、即食化解决滋补痛点的公司，涉及五个滋补品类100多个产品。公司自2018年起集中资源重点打造官栈品牌，官栈以花胶消费品为切入点，先后打造了即食花胶、鲜炖花胶、金汤花胶鸡等品类原型。

name: 寻因生物
description: 寻因生物是真格基金在2018年投资的天使项目，为自主研发单细胞技术的精准医疗生物医药企业。公司是国内独家拥有微孔芯片与油包水双技术的平台，致力于通过国产高通量单细胞全链条产品及服务，将单细胞技术普适化，应用于临床及药物研发，助力相关疾病研究。

name: 小红书
description: 小红书是真格在2013年投资的天使项目，是年轻人的生活方式平台。小红书以“Inspire Lives 分享和发现世界的精彩”为使命，用户可以通过短视频、图文等形式记录生活点滴，分享生活方式，并基于兴趣形成互动。

name: 小鱼易连
description: 小鱼易连是真格基金在2016年投资的早期项目，是中国领先的高品质云视频专家，专注为政府、公检法司、教育、金融、医疗等行业及企业用户提供“云、端、AI、开发平台”四位一体的云视频解决方案，具有全网络环境下超高清、低延时、安全、可靠等特点。

name: 应脉医疗
description: 应脉医疗是真格基金在2020年投资的天使项目，致力于创新医疗器械的产品开发、 生产和销售。是一家自主研发和海外技术引进相结合的创新医疗器械平台型企业，业务涵盖结构性心脏病、外周血管介入、神经刺激和脑机接口平台等领域，目前有包括胸主动脉覆膜支架系统在内的4项III类医疗器械产品取得了NMPA注册证，另有包括二尖瓣修复系统在内的多项产品在研发和临床进程中。

name: 循环智能
description: 循环智能是真格基金在2019年投资的早期项目，专注于 SalesTech（科技赋能销售）领域的人与人沟通场景，借助原创的自然语言处理和深度学习技术，帮助在线上线下依靠大量 Agent 人员（销售顾问、销售代表、经纪人、代理人、客户经理等）与客户进行沟通的企业，充分挖掘持续产生的“对话数据”的价值，帮助企业实现对话数据驱动的精细化运营与业务增长。

name: 态创生物
description: 态创生物是真格基金在2021年投资的早期项目，态创是国内第一家在生物科技领域实现跨物质种类产业化、商业化落地的企业，旨在利用生物合成技术，用更少的资源和生产原料合成更多人类需要的物质，引领生物技术领域的“新一轮工业革命”。 发展迄今，已在生物能源、生物材料、医疗技术以及美容美肤等诸多领域取得了令人瞩目的成就。

name: 怒喵科技
description: 怒喵科技是真格在2020年投资的早期项目。怒喵科技定位于全球化的3C潮品品牌，采用Community Driven Creation（社区共创）模式营销。前期主要在Reddit、Discord等社区发布产品信息，最后引流至shopify购买店铺。用户画像为热爱设计、潮流的年轻高收入极客。

name: 思谋科技
description: 思谋科技是真格基金在2020年投资的早期项目，是一家行业领先的新一代视觉AI前沿技术公司。公司以助力高端智能制造、赋能超高清视频为发力方向，全力服务产业转型升级和社会经济发展。公司业务覆盖消费电子、汽车、半导体、新能源、广播影视、文教旅游、智能交通等多个行业。目前已服务了卡尔蔡司、空客、博世、佳能、大陆集团、舍弗勒、宝洁、联合利华等超过100家行业头部企业。

name: 所思科技
description: 所思科技是真格在2017年投资的天使项目，是一家VR／AR行业软硬件技术公司，专注于VR通用型软件（如：浏览器、通话、视频等）。其游戏产品Party Animals 测试版本在 7天时间，创造了 STEAM 平台上中国游戏公司历史记录：全球第四。同时也打破了中国游戏在 STEAM 的 Wishlist、全球 DEMO 总玩家数、DEMO 同时在线的所有历史记录。

name: 找钢网
description: 找钢网是真格在2012年投资的早期项目，是行业内唯一一家采用标准创投模式成立的公司。找钢网始终以变革钢铁流通贸易模式、助力钢铁行业转型升级为愿景，是中国最大的钢铁全产业链电商平台。

name: 拉面说
description: 拉面说是真格基金在2018年投资的早期项目，日式拉面品牌，其产品通过熬制十几个小时、灌装工艺制得。拉面说旨在让消费者在家煮出好吃的日本拉面，产品针对于工作很忙但对生活品质有追求的年轻人。从外观上看，包装精美高端，以绘制了日式风格食材的方形纸盒包装；从内里来看，遵循“所见即所得”，面、叉烧、麻笋、木耳、葱花等配料一应俱全。

name: 无双医疗
description: 无双医疗是真格基金在2018年投资的早期项目，是专注于心脏节律管理（下称“CRM”）相关医疗器械研发和产业化的硬科技企业。无双医疗从CRM领域技术难度最高的产品ICD入手，构建了完整的CRM技术平台，正在成长为中国CRM领域全线产品的供应商，能够为广大心律失常患者提供从监测、诊断、治疗到术后随访的全套解决方案。

name: 日志易
description: 日志易是真格基金2014年投资的天使项目，专注于机器大数据平台、服务和解决方案的开发商，致力于帮助各行各业用户挖掘和利用机器数据价值，提升数字化运营能力，轻松应对IT及业务挑战。

name: 易仓
description: 易仓科技是真格在2020年投资的早期项目，公司致力于研发高效可控的跨境管理模式。精研跨境电商ERP、国际物流TMS、海外仓WMS和跨境分销M2B等管理系统。易仓目前已和国内外众多跨境卖家、海外仓服务商和国际物流等跨境巨头合作。发展成为跨境软件行业的头部企业，且是跨境行业中第一家拥有完整中台系统的服务商。

name: 易慕峰
description: 易慕峰是一家致力于突破实体瘤治疗，给患者带来长期生存获益的免疫细胞治疗药物开发企业，于2020年9月启动运营。 公司从实体瘤治疗痛点和临床获益出发，构建了成体系的技术平台和研发管线。以降低CAR-T产品安全性风险为突破口，公司在全球范围内首次提出“化实体瘤为血液瘤”的临床策略，旨在提高CAR-T产品的安全性、对抗肿瘤异质性以及提高扩增和浸润肿瘤的能力。

name: 晶泰科技
description: 晶泰科技是真格基金在2016年投资的早期项目，一家量子物理与人工智能赋能的药物研发公司，通过提高药物研发的速度、规模、创新性和成功率，致力于实现药物研发的行业革新。晶泰科技已建立起一整套量子物理干实验室与先进湿实验室紧密结合的研发迭代流程，挑战传统研发的效率瓶颈，赋能新药研发实现创新速度与规模的突破。

name: 智齿科技
description: 智齿科技是真格基金在2015年投资的天使项目，一体化客户联络解决方案提供商。智齿科技不断整合前沿的人工智能及大数据技术，已经构建形成呼叫中心、机器人「在线+呼入+呼出」、 人工在线客服、工单、企微智客等多个软件产品、并提供BPO外包服务。

name: 曦智科技
description: 曦智科技是真格基金在2017年投资的天使项目，是全球第一家以光计算为核心的人工智能芯片公司。团队目前正在全力研发光学芯片的相关技术，包含芯片设计、核心算法、传输、周边等。2019年4月，曦智科技正式发布了全球首款光子芯片原型板卡，成功将当时占据了半个实验室的整个光子计算系统集成到了常规大小的板卡上。

name: 月之暗面
description: 月之暗面（Moonshot AI）创立于 2023 年 3 月，是一家国内通用人工智能领域的创业公司。月之暗面致力于寻求将能源转化为智能的最优解，并通过产品与用户共创智能。创始团队核心成员参与了 Google Gemini、Google Bard、盘古 NLP、悟道等多个大模型的研发，多项核心技术被 Google PaLM、Meta LLaMa、Stable Diffusion 等主流产品采用。 2023 年 10 月，月之暗面推出首个支持输入 20 万汉字的对话式 AI 产品—— Kimi 智能助手。

name: 有个机器人
description: 有个机器人是真格基金在2018年投资的早期项目，公司致力于以先进的机器人技术赋能末端配送行业，创造全新的物质移动方式，塑造人机共存的未来生活。从创立之初，YOGO就进入了智能配送领域。公司开发的go系列配送服务机器人，使用创新自研的Gol算法，实现了移动机器人室内自主移动的安全性和流畅性，在地图构建、定位导航和运动控制等技术方向上均取得突破性成果。2017年，YOGO行业创新性楼宇配送机器人服务公司，扎根配送领域，并迅速迭代。于2019年初正式发布群体机器人配送解决方案，系统性地满足了末端配送各环节需求，让楼宇内真正的无人配送成为可能。

name: 未名拾光
description: 未名拾光由北京⼤学（蛋⽩质与植物基因研究国家重点实验室）和清华⼤学（工业生物催化重点实验室）的多位博⼠联合创建，是一家以合成生成物学为基础，以极致的科研创新为驱动力，专注于生物基创新原料研发及生产的科技公司。未名拾光在美容与护肤领域持续发力，自主搭建了多个生物智造平台，致力于从自然界中寻找极具性能的生物活性成分，经过结构优化设计最终完成产出。

name: 未知君
description: 未知君是真格基金在2018年投资的早期项目，是国内行业领先的专注于肠道微生物治疗的AI制药公司，旨在通过粪菌移植、配方菌等微生物治疗方式，实现肠道及其他系统性疾病的缓解或治疗。依托创新型药物开发模式和自研的药物开发平台，未知君将人工智能与肠道微生物技术相结合，实现数据高质量分析、沉淀与产出，极大地提高了药物开发的效率和成功率，有力将微生态制药从实验室阶段的科学探索，推向产业化的落地。

name: 杉数科技
description: 杉数科技是真格基金2016年投资的天使项目，是一家致力于决策优化技术的人工智能公司，依托于世界领先的深层次数据优化算法和复杂决策模型的求解能力，杉数科技为企业在海量数据环境下的复杂问题提供解决方案，利用数据为企业带来收益及成本端的显著变化，真正让每一个企业拥有定制最优化决策的能力。

name: 来也科技
description: 来也科技是真格基金在2015年投资的天使项目，RPA+AI 行业领导者，为客户提供变革性的智能自动化解决方案，助力政企实现智能时代的人机协同。其产品是一套智能自动化平台，包含机器人流程自动化（RPA）、智能文档处理（IDP）、对话式AI（Conversational AI）等。基于这一平台，能够根据客户需要，构造各种不同类型的软件机器人，实现业务流程的自动化，全面提升业务效率。

name: 格灵深瞳
description: 格灵深瞳是真格基金在2013年投资的天使项目，是一家行业领先的人工智能公司。公司专注于将先进的计算机视觉技术和大数据分析技术与应用场景深度融合，提供面向城市管理、智慧金融、商业零售、体育健康、轨交运维等领域的人工智能产品及解决方案。格灵深瞳自主研发的深瞳技术在视觉感知、数据智能挖掘、高性能计算等领域居于世界领先地位，多次在国际/国内人工智能算法测试中斩获桂冠。2021年11月，格灵深瞳科创板上市过会。

name: 森亿智能
description: 森亿智能是真格基金在2016年投资的天使项目，是一家中国智慧医院整体解决方案提供商。公司致力于为医院提供专业、高效的数据化、智能化新基建解决方案。以数据集成与治理、智慧科研、智慧临床、智慧管理为特色的森亿智慧医院全局解决方案具备完整知识产权，为医疗行业首个适配华为鲲鹏处理器体系的大数据产品，现已服务150余家三甲医院，赋能医院人工智能建设。

name: 沐曦集成电路
description: 沐曦是真格基金在2020年投资的早期项目，公司致力于为异构计算提供高性能GPU芯片和解决方案。沐曦已与主流人工智能企业、服务器OEM厂商、大数据中心、科学计算中心、互联网运营商、高等院校等目标客户建立了紧密的合作关系，将GPU核心技术研发与国内应用市场深度结合，充分推进产业上下游生态的建设。

name: 溪木源
description: 溪木源是真格基金在2019年投资的天使项目，极具科学精神的功能性天然护肤品牌，自创立伊始，溪木源一直倡导“全球溯源，国人定制”理念。品牌一直探寻自然界的植物、矿物、水及生物等多元化成分，溯源全球顶尖的科研技术，并基于中国及亚洲人的独特肌肤特点和生活环境进行研发，满足亚洲肌肤问题需求，通过原料定制、机理机制研究、原创配方，达到安全、有效、愉悦的护肤体验。

name: 潞晨科技
description: 潞晨科技致力于解放AI生产力，是真格基金在2021年投资的天使项目。公司打造的面向大模型时代的通用深度学习系统Colossal-AI，可实现高效快速部署 AI 大模型训练和推理，降低 AI 大模型应用成本。Colossal-AI 相关解决方案已成功在自动驾驶、云计算、零售、医药、芯片、金融等行业知名厂商落地应用，广受好评。

name: 瀚博半导体
description: 瀚博半导体是真格基金在2018年投资的天使项目，公司专注于研发高性能通用加速芯片，针对多种深度学习推理负载而优化，为计算机视觉、智能视频处理、自然语言处理等应用场景，提供低延时、高吞吐的异构计算性能和高效的性能/功耗比。芯片解决方案覆盖从云端到边缘的服务器及一体机市场。

name: 灵明光子
description: 灵明光子是真格基金在2018年投资的天使项目，公司致力于用世界领先的单光子探测器技术研发制造高性能光电3D传感（dToF）芯片，应用于手机3D模组、激光雷达和其它高性能深度传感系统，帮助智能硬件实现三维感知能力的飞跃。

name: 炬星
description: 炬星是真格基金在2019年投资的早期项目，是国内最早专注AMR（自主移动机器人）软硬件及云服务研发的企业。公司致力于为千行百业提供未来生产力。目前，其解决方案已在仓储物流领域成熟落地，为客户实现低门槛的柔性智能仓转型，服务对象包括世界级电商、零售巨头和物流集团。此外，全套技术体系已实现高度标准化，可向其他商用领域快速迁移。

name: 燧原科技
description: 燧原科技是真格基金在2018年投资的天使项目，公司专注人工智能领域云端算力平台，致力为人工智能产业发展提供普惠的基础设施解决方案，提供自主知识产权的高算力、高能效比、可编程的通用人工智能训练和推理产品。

name: 爱笔智能
description: 爱笔智能是真格基金在2017年投资的天使项目。Aibee（爱笔智能）是一家专注线下空间数字化与智能化的AI独角兽企业，致力于"赋能升级垂直行业，打磨极致AI技术"。融合计算机视觉、大数据分析、机器人等多模态人工智能技术，在市场上首个实现线下空间全场景、全流程、全量数字化，帮助线下空间走向智能化的运营、管理和触达。

name: 白菜二手车
description: 白菜二手车是真格在2021年投资的早期项目，是58同城旗下专注于二手车新零售的交易服务平台，包括线上二手车商城及线下二手车连锁超市，于2021年正式从58二手车拆分并独立运营，以“人人信赖的二手车交易服务平台”为愿景，致力于通过技术、产品构建从业者、供应者和消费者之间多层、立体的二手车交易服务体系，为消费者提供更美好的二手车交易服务体验。

name: 真固生物
description: 真固生物是真格2014年投资的天使项目。上海真固生物科技有限公司，是一家兼具中国文化基因和美国科技背景的精准医疗技术公司，致力于以NGS为核心的IVD产品研发转化，以及临床级精准诊断整体解决方案的开发应用。公司拥有成熟的针对全样本类型的高通量测序“一管”文库制备技术和基于RNA的融合基因检测技术；与试剂搭配的易学易用的生物信息学分析软件，可以“一键”完成从原始数据到突变列表注释的全部数据分析流程。同时搭建了从样本提取到报告的全流程自动化、“一体化”院内LDT/IVD整体解决方案，使高通量测序可以在院内实现“一天”级实验流和“两天”级工作流。目前，公司已获得包括美国FDA、中国NMPA、欧盟CE在内的三地NGS跨癌种通用伴随诊断试剂盒注册证，是全球首家获此殊荣的NGS精准诊断产品供应商，也是全球首个同时拥有中美两地LDT项目落地经验的NGS诊断企业。

name: 社保通
description: 社保通是真格基金2015年投资的天使项目，以服务员工、服务企业、服务民生为目标，创建一站式线上线下人力资源服务体系，为企业用户提供社保/公积金代理、商业保险、薪酬服务、服务外包、劳务派遣、人力成本优化等服务项目。

name: 穴居人
description: 穴居人是真格在2019年投资的天使项目，穴居人是一家VR游戏开发公司。公司旗下有多人在线FPS VR游戏《Contractors》等VR游戏作品。该游戏上线不到半年时间 ，便在Oculus和Steam双平台销量突破50000份，上线Quest平台后，总量快速上升到10多万份。穴居人也凭借该游戏获得Oculus开发者资金支持。

name: 美菜
description: 美菜网是真格在2014年投资的天使项目，是国内餐饮供应链杰出服务商。致力于用互联网思维去改变国内现代农业和餐饮供应链。以独有的“两端一链一平台”模式，创新升级农产品供应链，提高流通效率，让利两端。专注为全国近千万家餐厅，提供全品类、全程无忧的一站式餐饮食材采购服务。

name: 舞肌科技 PAN MOTOR
description: 舞肌科技（Pan Motor）是一家专业从事电机设计、研发、生产和销售的高科技企业，提供各种类型的电机产品和服务。舞肌科技由一位年轻的工程师创立于 2019 年。彼时，他对机器人中电机技术的现状感到不满——竟然没有电机能够以更低的重量或更低的损耗提供足够高的扭矩，从而限制了机器人系统的性能。团队经过了 3 年的不懈努力，终于推出了具有 SotA 扭矩密度的F系列产品。F 系列电机拥有同等尺寸或重量下 SotA 的扭矩密度，在 200g 的重量下可以产生 8Nm 的峰值扭矩。

name: 艾科诺
description: 艾科诺是真格基金在2019年投资的早期项目，一家专注于体外诊断行业的高新技术企业。公司以分子诊断作为重点，将开发推广一系列独有的用于传染病等重症疾病诊断的仪器平台和检测试剂，以适应国内外市场的需求。

name: 芯华章
description: 芯华章是真格基金在2020年投资的早期项目，以智能调试、智能编译、智能验证座舱为三大基座，提供全面覆盖数字芯片验证需求的五大产品线，包括：硬件仿真系统、FPGA原型验证系统、智能验证、形式验证以及逻辑仿真。 同时，芯华章致力于面向未来的EDA 2.0 软件和智能化电子设计平台的研究与开发，以技术革新加速芯片创新效率，让芯片设计更简单、更普惠。

name: 芯耀辉
description: 芯耀辉科技是真格基金在2021年投资的天使项目，是一家致力于先进半导体IP研发和服务、赋能芯片设计和系统应用的高科技公司，通过自主研发先进工艺芯片IP产品，以响应中国快速发展的芯片和应用需求，全面赋能芯片设计。

name: 虹宇科技
description: 虹宇科技是真格在2017年投资的天使项目，专注于打造服务于 AR/VR 等下一代终端设备的新一代操作系统。公司希望通过对下一代应用体系的探索、实践与推广，助力空间互联网的到来，促进人与信息更高效、更便捷的互动。其自主研发用于VR/AR的全新3D系统——IrisView。目前显示合成方面的底层框架(类似于3D版X WindowSystem)及API已搭建完成,并且已经为国内领先的数家AR硬件厂商提供底层系统技术服务。虽然成立仅两年多时间，但已凭借自主研发的IRIS系统等高精尖技术优势，迅速成长为国内AR、VR核心软件技术领域的佼佼者。

name: 观夏
description: 观夏是真格基金在2018年投资的天使项目，公司致力于建设香气与健康的生活方式品牌，定位为“专注香氛疗愈与健康生活的品牌”，采取徒手采摘花草的收割方式收集原材料，专注研发以有机植物成分为来源的情绪香薰、花草茶和身体洗护类产品。

name: 豪思生物
description: 豪思生物是真格基金在2016年投资的天使项目，是一家专注质谱精准医疗的研发型高新技术企业，致力于提供质谱检测领域整体解决方案包括试剂盒产品、医学检验实验室和质谱技术科研合作等。公司自主研发了一系列特色临床质谱筛查产品，包括阿尔兹海默症、心血管疾病、泌尿疾病等重大疾病早期筛查诊断、药物浓度监测、维生素检测、脂肪酸谱检测、胆汁酸谱检测、儿茶酚胺类激素检测、多种氨基酸检测等质谱检测产品和服务。

name: 赛博昆仑
description: 赛博昆仑是真格基金在2021年投资的天使项目，专注于提供零日漏洞独家防御能力的新一代网络空间安全公司。以具备国际顶级漏洞能力的昆仑实验室为核心驱动力，基于独有的安全技术和情报能力，构建了覆盖多个领域与产业需求的新一代网络安全产品与服务平台。公司致力于为政府、金融、能源、运营商、教育、医疗、互联网等行业客户提供全球最尖端的、面向未来的高级网络安全产品、解决方案与服务。

name: 赛舵智能
description: 赛舵智能是真格基金在2019年投资的天使项目，是一家智能客服产品研发商。主要聚焦语音识别、语音合成、自然语言处理和语义理解相关技术和应用，致力于为当地金融科技企业及传统金融机构提供本地化的催收、质检等AI智能客服产品及服务，解决客户在客服方面的痛点。

name: 赛陆医疗
description: 赛陆医疗是真格基金在2020年投资的天使项目，是全球首个兼具测序和超分辨组学平台的企业。公司专注于开发自主知识产权的上游测序平台，并基于其上构建了全球领先的超分辨空间组学平台，实现基因组学和空间组学产品的自主开发及科研临床端转化。公司突破了以往测序产品在通量、成本、分辨率、自动化等方面的瓶颈，同时实现了平台的国产化。

name: 达观数据
description: 达观数据是真格基金在2015年投资的天使项目，是一家专注于文本智能处理技术的国家高新技术企业，利用先进的自然语言理解、自然语言生成、知识图谱等技术，为大型企业和政府客户提供文本自动抽取、审核、纠错、搜索、推荐、写作等智能软件系统，让计算机代替人工完成业务流程自动化，大幅度提高企业效率。

name: 逸仙电商
description: YSG) 是真格基金在2016年投资的天使项目。逸仙电商创立于2016年，于2020年11月正式在纽交所挂牌上市，成为最年轻的中国美妆上市企业。 以“新科技时代的健康美丽探索者”作为长期愿景，公司旗下拥有Perfect Diary完美日记、Little Ondine小奥汀、Galénic法国科兰黎、DR.WU达尔肤（中国大陆业务）、EVE LOM、Pink Bear皮可熊、壹安态等多个高成长性的彩妆及护肤品牌。

name: 销售易
description: 销售易是真格基金在2016年投资的早期项目，致力于通过新型互联网技术，打造符合数字化时代下企业需求的新一代CRM产品，将企业同客户互动的全过程数字化、智能化，帮助企业转型为真正以客户为中心的数字化运营组织，实现业绩的可持续增长。

name: 锐讯生物
description: 锐讯生物是真格基金在2017年投资的天使项目，以创新、智造、服务健康为使命，产品涵盖数字PCR系统、微流控mRNA LNP递送体系解决方案、体外诊断试剂三大板块。创始团队为来自美国常春藤盟校和国际知名大学的博士，拥有扎实的学术背景和丰富的工业界经验。多次参与和主导多款业内知名产品的开发。锐讯生物自成立以来已经获得国内知名投资机构真格基金、火山石资本、明势资本、元生创投等数近亿元投资。

name: 长亭科技
description: 长亭科技是真格基金在2015年投资的天使项目，专注为企业级用户提供专业的网络信息安全解决方案。创新发布基于人工智能语义分析的下一代 Web 应用防火墙，颠覆了传统依赖规则防护的工作原理，为企业用户带来更智能、更简单、更省心的安全产品及服务。

name: 雪加
description: 雪加电子烟是真格基金在2017年投资的天使项目，一款集品质、时尚为一体的减害替烟产品。雪加 SNOWPLUS隶属于深圳雪雾科技有限公司， 致力于带给全球健康觉醒者一个改变的理由， 让健康的生活方式成为主流，让未来提前发生。公司在美国和深圳设立了研发基地，产品采用 TrueFeel 蜂窝陶瓷雾化技术、Aeroflow 进气技术；除了参照国内已有的食品级标准，雪加在安全性方面也通过了多项第三方认证，雾化芯、烟嘴等核心组件符合FDA和欧盟的医用级最高安全标准。

name: 霸蛮
description: 霸蛮是真格基金在2014年投资的天使项目。霸蛮以“敢拼要赢”的精神内核打造品牌人设，被越来越多的年轻消费者追捧；通过堂食+外卖+小吃外带+零售分销的“无界餐饮”模式，打造极致门店，建立“米粉=霸蛮”的品牌心智。

name: 青藤云安全
description: 青藤云安全是真格基金在2014年投资的天使项目，是中国主机自适应安全开创者、云原生安全领军企业。公司聚焦于关键信息基础设施安全防护，提供包括主机安全、云安全、大数据安全等新一代信息安全技术，帮助用户构建更加强大的安全保障体系。

name: 非夕机器人
description: 非夕是真格基金在2017年投资的早期项目，是一家全球技术领先的AI机器人公司。公司专注于研发、生产集高精度力控、计算机视觉和人工智能技术于一体的自适应机器人产品，为不同行业的客户提供基于机器人系统的整体、创新性的解决方案和服务。

name: 领智创信advance.ai
description: 领创集团（Advance Intelligence Group）是真格在2015年投资的早期项目，是AI技术驱动的科技集团，旗下包括企业服务（ADVANCE.AI）、消费者服务（Atome Financial）和商家服务（Ginee）。）目前，集团已完成D轮融资，业务覆盖新加坡、印度尼西亚、中国大陆、印度、越南、菲律宾、马来西亚、中国香港、泰国、中国台湾、墨西哥、巴基斯坦等12个市场地区。

name: 驭势科技
description: 驭势科技是真格基金在2016年投资的早期项目，公司致力于为全行业、全场景提供AI驾驶服务，做赋能出行和物流新生态的AI驾驶员。依托自主研发的U-Drive®智能驾驶平台，驭势科技在业务上已经形成可规模化部署的L3-L4级智能驾驶系统，可以满足多场景、高级别的自动驾驶需求。2019年，公司率先在机场和厂区领域实现了“去安全员” 无人驾驶常态化运营的重大突破，落地“全场景、真无人、全天候”的自动驾驶技术，并由此迈向大规模商用。

name: 黑湖智造
description: 黑湖智造是真格基金2016年投资的天使项目，专注打造利用数据驱动生产效率提升的制造协同SaaS软件，通过高效的数据聚合、精准的数据分发、实时的数据协同，打破生产管理和供应链协作中的“信息孤岛”， 优化生产、质量、物料、设备全流程，提高生产柔性、缩短交付周期、优化物流效率，帮助工厂迅速响应消费者个性化需求，由“设计定义制造”向“需求定义制造”转型。

name: 默安科技
description: 默安科技是真格基金在2016年投资的天使项目，是一家云计算时代的新兴网络安全公司，为政府和企业建立围绕左移开发安全（DevSecOps）与智慧运营安全（AISecOps）的下一代企业安全体系，当前已在北京、上海、广州、深圳以及其它十余个省份完成业务和服务网络的覆盖，形成多地研发、营销和服务的战略格局。
